title: Crüger to Müller, Easter Tuesday 1635
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller of Easter Tuesday 1635, written at Danzig, reporting what Kepler's son Ludwig, passing through Danzig with the English ambassador, had told him of his stepmother and her children, of his father's papers, and of Tycho's observations. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. Cc. 49). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 111–112.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Crüger reports a visit from Kepler's son Ludwig: the widow and children are stranded at Frankfurt, Kepler's papers are kept at Sagan, and the Emperor's debt might be used to win Tycho's observations for an edition at Danzig.

notes.note: Kepler's son by his first marriage (1607–1663), later a physician at Königsberg; he had published his father's *Somnium* in 1634.
